newsitem.title: USA: Lukens sees strong plate steel shipments.
newsitem.headline: Lukens sees strong plate steel shipments.

text.p: Specialty steel maker Lukens Inc said Tuesday said strong plate steel shipments are expected to continue into the second half of the year based on healthy demand in capital goods markets.
But it also said high import levels will put pressure on stainless selling prices through year-end.

The company issued its expectations as it reported second quarter net earnings of $1.2 million compared to a year-ago net loss of $5.7 million. Lukens said record carbon and alloy group shipments, coupled with the benefits from a two-year cost reduction program, drove the improvement.
Meanwhile, high levels of stainless imports continued to exert pressure on domestic selling prices, it said.
